title: The 1980s Underground: Cassette Culture and Club Fekete Lyuk
grammar: Colloquial clipping, hypocoristics, and youth slang compounds (*-csi, -kó, uncsi, koli, pulcsi*)
goal: I can analyze the 1980s Budapest underground rock scene, cassette culture, and the sanctuary of Club Fekete Lyuk.
I can recognize and appropriately use colloquial clipping (szócsonkítás) and affectionate suffixes in informal registers.
I can articulate the tension between state censorship, surveillance, and countercultural music.
